main.description: Move a giveaway's closing date later, as its author. The AppView records the date it verified and rejects a record whose date disagrees, which is what stops a hand-edited record from ending a giveaway early. The caller authenticates with an atproto service token minted by their own PDS.

closesAt.description: The date the AppView now verifies. A caller must write exactly this into the record.
